subject: About the squid
body:
A word of warning about the squid. They have a very big, very angry relative.

It answers to ink. Use 8 Ink Sacs on a Chiseled Tidestone touching the water in the Elythian seas, like the ones in those old ruins, and it WILL come up. Do not stand too close when the sea goes quiet. It doesn't just rule the sea either. It commands the skies too. Somehow.

And if you kill a squid while you have Bad Omen it might come after you anyway, so maybe don't do that.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
